{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_ARTIE",
      "name": "Arthur 'Artie' Penhaligon",
      "intro": {
        "chapter": 1,
        "scene": 1
      },
      "pronouns": "he/him",
      "role": "protagonist"
    },
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_CLERK",
      "name": "System Clerk 01",
      "intro": {
        "chapter": 1,
        "scene": 1
      },
      "role": "tutorial_guide"
    },
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_VANCE",
      "name": "Guild Master Vance",
      "intro": {
        "chapter": 2,
        "scene": 2
      },
      "role": "mentor_antagonist"
    },
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_CORRECTOR",
      "name": "System Corrector 734",
      "intro": {
        "chapter": 5,
        "scene": 1
      },
      "role": "primary_antagonist"
    }
  ],
  "threads": [
    {
      "thread_id": "THREAD_CRIT_BUG",
      "label": "The 100% Crit Rate Exploit",
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "thread_id": "THREAD_BOUNTY",
      "label": "The System Integrity Bounty",
      "status": "pending"
    },
    {
      "thread_id": "THREAD_SOURCE_CODE",
      "label": "The World Source Code Mystery",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The 1% Chance of Survival",
      "goal": "Survive the initial transition by exploiting a 100% crit-rate bug on a tutorial boss.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From certain death to possessing an unintended mechanical advantage.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Protagonist dies in the real world due to a freak statistical anomaly.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist enters the first hub city with a bag full of 'impossible' tutorial loot."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Final Calculation",
          "intent": "Establish the protagonist's death and transition into the system.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arthur dies in a hospital and wakes up in the System's white void.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur accepts the terms of the isekai contract.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_CLERK"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_CLERK"],
              "location_start_label": "Hospital Room",
              "location_start": "St. Jude's Hospital, Room 402",
              "location_end_label": "System Void",
              "location_end": "The White Waiting Room of the System",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "The hospital heart monitor emitted a long, flat beep before the sterile room dissolved into a blinding white expanse.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["heart monitor", "flat beep", "sterile room", "blinding white"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur signed the digital contract, and the Clerk gestured toward a floating interface.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["digital contract", "floating interface", "Clerk"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Arthur navigates the character creation screen and spots a math error in the Agility stat.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur discovers the Speed-to-Crit conversion exploit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "System Void",
              "location_start": "The White Waiting Room of the System",
              "location_end_label": "System Void",
              "location_end": "The White Waiting Room of the System",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The floating interface flickered to life, displaying a list of stats that didn't quite add up to Arthur's mathematical mind.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["floating interface", "stats", "mathematical mind"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur allocated his points with a smirk, locking in the glitchy build.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["points", "glitchy build", "smirk"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arthur finishes his build and is transported to the entrance of the tutorial zone.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur prepares to enter the tutorial with his exploited stats.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "System Void",
              "location_start": "The White Waiting Room of the System",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Gate",
              "location_end": "The Archway of the First Trial",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_in_text": "A sudden rush of wind pulled Arthur through the void, depositing him on a stone path facing a massive iron gate.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rush of wind", "stone path", "iron gate"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur stepped toward the iron gate, feeling the weight of his new reality.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["iron gate", "new reality"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Debugging the Tutorial",
          "intent": "Explore the mechanics of the 100% crit bug.",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss spawns in the arena.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Arthur enters the Tutorial Forest and encounters his first enemies, the Slimes.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Arthur confirms that every hit is a critical strike.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Gate",
              "location_start": "The Archway of the First Trial",
              "location_end_label": "Slime Clearing",
              "location_end": "The Emerald Glade of the Tutorial Forest",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_in_text": "The iron gate creaked open, revealing a lush forest where green slimes bounced with murderous intent.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["iron gate", "lush forest", "green slimes"],
              "transition_out_text": "The last slime popped like a balloon, leaving behind a trail of critical hit notifications.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime", "balloon", "critical hit notifications"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arthur experiments with movement speed to see how it affects his crit damage multiplier.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur realizes the exploit scales infinitely with movement speed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Slime Clearing",
              "location_start": "The Emerald Glade of the Tutorial Forest",
              "location_end_label": "Slime Clearing",
              "location_end": "The Emerald Glade of the Tutorial Forest",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur began to sprint in circles, watching the numbers on his HUD climb higher with every step.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sprint", "circles", "HUD"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur stopped his sprint, his breath hitching as he saw the damage multiplier reach four digits.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sprint", "damage multiplier", "four digits"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Arthur finds a hidden chest containing the 'Boots of the Swift' which further boosts his speed.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur acquires gear that perfectly complements his exploit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Slime Clearing",
              "location_start": "The Emerald Glade of the Tutorial Forest",
              "location_end_label": "Hidden Grotto",
              "location_end": "A mossy alcove behind the Tutorial Waterfall",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur pushed through a curtain of water, finding a small cave where a wooden chest sat waiting.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["curtain of water", "small cave", "wooden chest"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur laced up the glowing boots, feeling the air rush around his ankles.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing boots", "air rush", "ankles"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Arthur reaches the end of the forest and approaches the Boss Arena.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur prepares for the final tutorial challenge.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Hidden Grotto",
              "location_start": "A mossy alcove behind the Tutorial Waterfall",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena Entrance",
              "location_end": "The Stone Steps of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "The forest thinned out, giving way to a massive stone structure that loomed over the landscape.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["forest", "stone structure", "landscape"],
              "transition_out_text": "The ground shook as the arena doors began to rise, revealing a dark interior.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["ground shook", "arena doors", "dark interior"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss spawns in the arena."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "One-Shot Wonder",
          "intent": "Conclude the tutorial by obliterating the boss.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "The Tutorial Boss, a Giant Golem, spawns and Arthur begins his 'Hit & Run' strategy.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Arthur successfully dodges the Golem's first massive strike.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena Entrance",
              "location_start": "The Stone Steps of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end": "The Sandy Floor of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur stepped onto the sand, and the Giant Golem pulled itself from the arena floor with a roar of grinding stone.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sand", "Giant Golem", "grinding stone"],
              "transition_out_text": "The Golem's fist smashed into the sand, but Arthur was already ten yards away.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Golem's fist", "sand", "ten yards"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Arthur builds up maximum speed and delivers a single, glitch-powered strike to the Golem.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "The Golem is instantly destroyed by a massive critical hit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "The Sandy Floor of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end": "The Sandy Floor of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur accelerated to a blur, his sword glowing with the purple light of a guaranteed critical strike.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blur", "sword", "purple light"],
              "transition_out_text": "The Golem exploded into a million digital shards, leaving only a shimmering blue portal in its wake.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Golem", "digital shards", "shimmering blue portal"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Arthur collects his legendary tutorial loot and steps into the portal.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur leaves the tutorial and enters the hub city.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "The Sandy Floor of the Tutorial Colosseum",
              "location_end_label": "Hub Portal",
              "location_end": "The Shimmering Gateway to Iron Gate City",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "transition_in_text": "The shimmering blue portal hummed with energy, beckoning Arthur to the world beyond the tutorial.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shimmering blue portal", "energy", "world beyond"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Looting the Narrative",
      "goal": "Identify the 'Speed-to-Crit' conversion exploit while navigating the starter city's bureaucracy.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From lucky survivor to deliberate exploiter of system physics.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arriving at the hub with high-tier loot and suspicious stats.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist joins a low-stakes dungeon crawl to test his 'Hit & Run' theory."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Iron Gate Bureaucracy",
          "intent": "Introduce the hub city and the protagonist's initial struggle with registration.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arthur arrives in Iron Gate City and is overwhelmed by the scale of the hub.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur finds his way to the Adventurer Guild.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Hub Portal",
              "location_start": "The Shimmering Gateway to Iron Gate City",
              "location_end_label": "City Plaza",
              "location_end": "The Central Square of Iron Gate City",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The portal spat Arthur out onto the sun-drenched cobblestones of a city that looked like a medieval fever dream.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["portal", "cobblestones", "medieval fever dream"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur followed the signs toward the massive building with the crossed-swords banner.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["signs", "massive building", "crossed-swords banner"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Arthur enters the Adventurer Guild and meets Guild Master Vance, who is suspicious of Arthur's level.",
              "type": "dialogue",
              "outcome": "Arthur realizes he needs to hide his true stats.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANCE"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_VANCE"],
              "location_start_label": "City Plaza",
              "location_start": "The Central Square of Iron Gate City",
              "location_end_label": "Guild Lobby",
              "location_end": "The Oak-Paneled Reception of the Adventurer Guild",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The Guild Lobby smelled of old parchment and expensive ale, dominated by a man with a chest like a beer keg.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["Guild Lobby", "old parchment", "expensive ale", "beer keg"],
              "transition_out_text": "Vance narrowed his eyes at Arthur's registration form, his hand hovering over a detection crystal.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Vance", "registration form", "detection crystal"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arthur uses a 'Lesser Illusion' scroll to mask his stats and completes his registration.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur is officially registered as a Level 1 Adventurer.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANCE"],
              "location_start_label": "Guild Lobby",
              "location_start": "The Oak-Paneled Reception of the Adventurer Guild",
              "location_end_label": "Guild Lobby",
              "location_end": "The Oak-Paneled Reception of the Adventurer Guild",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur surreptitiously cracked the illusion scroll beneath the counter, a faint shimmer masking his true power.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["illusion scroll", "counter", "faint shimmer"],
              "transition_out_text": "Vance grunted and stamped the paperwork, sliding a bronze guild tag across the wood.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Vance", "paperwork", "bronze guild tag"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Agility Loophole",
          "intent": "Experiment with the Speed-to-Crit conversion in a controlled environment.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Arthur finds a quiet training ground to test his build's limits without being watched.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur finds a secure location for his experiments.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Guild Lobby",
              "location_start": "The Oak-Paneled Reception of the Adventurer Guild",
              "location_end_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_end": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur ducked into the shadows of the lower district, finding a courtyard where the training dummies were more rot than straw.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shadows", "lower district", "training dummies"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur drew his sword, the blade catching a sliver of moonlight through the broken roof.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sword", "blade", "moonlight"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arthur equips several pieces of low-tier Agility gear he bought in the market.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur observes the crit-rate rising with every point of Agility.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_start": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "location_end_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_end": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur began donning the mismatched leather pieces, his Agility stat ticking upward with each buckle fastened.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["leather pieces", "Agility stat", "buckle"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur swung at the dummy, the air whistling as his speed surpassed the system's intended limits.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["dummy", "whistling", "intended limits"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Arthur reaches the mathematical threshold where his crit-rate locks at 100%.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "Arthur confirms the exploit is permanent as long as he maintains his Agility.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_start": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "location_end_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_end": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_in_text": "A golden notification flashed in Arthur's vision: 'CRIT_CHANCE: OVERFLOW'.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golden notification", "CRIT_CHANCE", "OVERFLOW"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur sheathed his sword, a dangerous confidence settling in his chest.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sword", "dangerous confidence", "chest"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Dressed for Success",
          "intent": "Acquire the necessary gear to leverage the exploit in a real dungeon.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Arthur visits a high-end blacksmith to commission specialized lightweight armor.",
              "type": "dialogue",
              "outcome": "Arthur acquires the 'Wind-Runner's Vest'.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_start": "An abandoned courtyard in the City's Slums",
              "location_end_label": "Blacksmith Shop",
              "location_end": "Ironheart's Forge in the Market District",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_in_text": "The heat of the forge hit Arthur like a physical wall as he stepped into the district's most famous smithy.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["heat", "forge", "smithy"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur left the shop with a lighter purse and a vest that felt like a second skin.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["shop", "lighter purse", "second skin"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Arthur travels to the outskirts of the city to the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Arthur is ready to begin his first real dungeon run.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Blacksmith Shop",
              "location_start": "Ironheart's Forge in the Market District",
              "location_end_label": "Sunken Crypt Entrance",
              "location_end": "The Fog-Drenched Entrance of the Sunken Crypt",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_in_text": "The city walls receded as Arthur walked toward the graveyard where the Sunken Crypt's entrance lay hidden in the fog.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["city walls", "graveyard", "fog"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
